Apple (AAPL) Shareholder Evermay Wealth Management Lowered Stake as Share Value Rose; Crestwood Capital Management LP Increased Fleetcor Technologies (FLT) Stake
June 13, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Michael R. Weisberg increased its stake in Fleetcor Technologies Inc (FLT) by 20% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Crestwood Capital Management Lp bought 4,320 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.90% with the market. The hedge fund run by Michael R. Weisberg held 25,920 shares of the miscellaneous company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.25M, up from 21,600 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Crestwood Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Fleetcor Technologies Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $18.37 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.07% or $2.17 during the last trading session, reaching $204.98. About 416,377 shares traded. FleetCor Technologies, Inc. (NYSE:FLT) has risen 43.29% since June 13, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 30.72% the S&P500. The institutional investor held 25,800 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.33 million, down from 28,649 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Evermay Wealth Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $945.08 billion market cap company.
